# ai

> Model-pinned ZCode and Codex sub-agents plus orchestration skills — one repo,
> one subfolder per harness. Installable by humans or AI agents in one command;
> no build step and no runtime dependencies beyond Node.

All content lives under `zcode/` (the ZCode harness kit: 3 sub-agents +
2 skills). To install everything, run `npx github:hmziqrs/ai` — it
copies agents into `~/.zcode/agents/` and skills into
`~/.agents/skills/`, then ZCode loads them at next session start.
Agent definitions must be regular files — ZCode's discovery
silently skips symlinks; `find ~/.zcode/agents -type l` printing
nothing confirms no symlinks.
Agents: follow [install.md](install.md) for task-oriented instructions.

The Codex kit lives under `codex/`. Install it with
`npx github:hmziqrs/ai codex`; it adds the Z.ai Responses provider, five custom
agents, six profiles, a two-model catalog, and four skills while preserving the
normal OpenAI default. The installer imports `ZAI_API_KEY` into the private
Codex-only file `~/.codex/secrets/zai-api-key` with mode `0600`; provider
authentication reads that file, and the key never enters Git or
`~/.codex/config.toml`. Full details: [codex/install.md](codex/install.md).

## Install — Codex + Z.ai kit

- [bin/codex-ai.js](bin/codex-ai.js): safe, idempotent Codex installer invoked
  through `npx github:hmziqrs/ai codex`.
- [codex/agents](codex/agents): `zai_flash`, `zai_vision`, `zai_pro`, and
  `zai_reviewer` at max reasoning, plus a low-effort read-only explorer.
- [codex/plugins/zai-workflows](codex/plugins/zai-workflows): publishable Codex
  plugin containing z-workflow, z-proflow, z-flashflow, and z-liteflow.

## Install — full kit (agents + skills)

- [bin/ai.js](bin/ai.js): the installer. `npx github:hmziqrs/ai`, `npx github:hmziqrs/ai uninstall`, flag `--zcode-skills`. Node >= 16, zero dependencies.
- [install.md](install.md): task-oriented instructions an AI agent can execute autonomously (environment check, install, verify, report).

## Install — skills only (skills.sh ecosystem)

- `npx skills add hmziqrs/ai -g -a zcode -y` installs the SKILL.md packs (z-workflow, z-proflow, z-flashflow, z-liteflow) into `~/.zcode/skills/` via the skills CLI. Verified invocation; other `-a` agent targets supported. Skills only — the sub-agent definitions under `zcode/agents/` are not handled by the skills CLI; use the full-kit installer for those.

## ZCode kit contents (`zcode/`)

- [zcode/agents/general-flash.md](zcode/agents/general-flash.md): full-tools general agent pinned to glm-5.3-flash — objectively checkable work (CRUD, boilerplate, mechanical verification).
- [zcode/agents/explore-flash.md](zcode/agents/explore-flash.md): read-only search + code-audit agent pinned to glm-5.3-flash — reports findings, no verdict authority.
- [zcode/agents/general-pro.md](zcode/agents/general-pro.md): full-tools judgment agent pinned to glm-5.3 — complex implementation, audit verdicts, continue/stop decisions.
- [zcode/skills/z-workflow/SKILL.md](zcode/skills/z-workflow/SKILL.md): thin chain coordinator over zflow-engine — pro implement and judge runs with a flash run-level vision node chained between rounds, looping per POLICY until clean or honestly stopped.
- [zcode/skills/z-proflow/SKILL.md](zcode/skills/z-proflow/SKILL.md): the all-pro depth-first chain — every run pinned to the pro tier via subagent_model, no router, no pixel vision (pro is image-blind; ocu AX-text structural audits allowed).
- [zcode/skills/z-flashflow/SKILL.md](zcode/skills/z-flashflow/SKILL.md): the all-flash chain — every run pinned to flash; gates, fresh blind judges, fix rounds, and code-enforced POLICY exits compensate; hands off to z-proflow when a complex area stalls.
- [zcode/skills/z-liteflow/SKILL.md](zcode/skills/z-liteflow/SKILL.md): lightweight chain for small single-domain tasks — flash implement and judge runs looping between runs, optional flash vision node.
- [zcode/skills/z-gpui-workflow/SKILL.md](zcode/skills/z-gpui-workflow/SKILL.md): fine-grained GPUI desktop chain — pro implement/judge runs, flash vision node for pixel design audits via ocu capture; main-thread computer-use plugin as interactive fallback only.
- [zcode/workflows/zflow-engine.dwf.ts](zcode/workflows/zflow-engine.dwf.ts): the ONE saved dynamic workflow all five z-flow skills chain over (implement / vision / judge nodes; world.run gate allowlist; Committer-drafted commits; POLICY as loop conditions in code). Installs as a saved workflow at ~/.zcode/workflows/ — zcode/workflows/ is the source copy. Contract: [zcode/workflows/zflow-SPEC.md](zcode/workflows/zflow-SPEC.md).

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): full documentation — layout, all install paths, how to add agents/skills/harnesses.
- [.zcode-plugin/plugin.json](.zcode-plugin/plugin.json): install as a ZCode plugin (Settings → Plugin Management → Discover → + → this Git URL).
- [.claude-plugin/marketplace.json](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): Claude Code marketplace manifest; also makes skills.sh discovery deterministic.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): orientation for AI agents working IN this repository (layout, conventions, extension rules).
